blocks.text: From her gown’s butterfly sleeves to her wide obi sash belt, Binibining Pilipinas International Katrina Anne Johnson was a vision of two cultures fused together by their shared history at the 2026 Miss International’s national costume presentation in in Yamanashi, Japan on Saturday, November 14. The pharmacist from Davao wore a creation by renowned fashion designer Manny Halasan which featured a champaign-colored gown that looked like a cross between a Filipiniana gown with its distinctive butterfly sleeves and a Japanese kimono with its wide obi sash and large ribbon at the back.
